title: Restore integer bounds from JSON schema cache
body:
### Motivation / Background

Apps that use a JSON schema cache can fail during fixture loading with `FrozenError: can't modify frozen ActiveModel::Type::Integer`.

The JSON loader restores integer types without calling `initialize`, so their minimum and maximum values are missing. Rails then freezes these types when it loads the model schema. The first attempt to serialize an integer tries to set the missing values, which fails because the type is frozen.

### Detail

Restore the minimum and maximum values when loading the integer type from JSON, before Rails freezes it. This lets fixture loading serialize integers without raising `FrozenError`.

### Additional information

The regression test loads a real JSON schema cache, freezes an integer column type, and checks that it can serialize a value. It raises `FrozenError` without the fix and passes with it. The 42 schema-cache and integer tests pass.

### Checklist

- [x] This PR contains one fix.
- [x] The commit message explains what changed and why.
- [x] A regression test is included.
- [x] The Active Model changelog is updated.
